summary: Frontend-only e2e retest of the 3 new web behaviors (wake-prompt on presence, technician privacy toggle, regression share flow) plus invoice text constants. All requested checks PASSED. Client at /conectar registers a support session on mount and keeps a presence WebSocket open without sharing (visible in admin panel within ~5s). When technician opens the viewer for that code, the client shows a centered [data-testid=wake-prompt] modal with a Começar button [data-testid=wake-start-btn]. Toggling [data-testid=ci-privacy-toggle] on the viewer shows a fullscreen black [data-testid=privacy-overlay] on the client with 'Ajuste Técnico' + 'Aguarde…', and clicking again removes it. Clicking Começar (with getDisplayMedia stubbed to a canvas MediaStream) starts sharing and the viewer status becomes 'Ligado — a ver o ecrã do cliente' with a live video element (480x270). Clicking [data-testid=ci-reconnect] re-establishes the connection to Ligado. Zero console errors on client, viewer, admin. Invoice constants confirmed by code review (invoicePdf.js line 12 email='victor.silva@wexfordadvisory-ltd.com', line 50 text='Documento Original'; the previous 'Original · Documento não certificado' phrase is fully removed).
critical_code_review_comments: SuporteDispositivo.jsx: register() POSTs on mount and openWs() keeps presence WS open even when not sharing — correct. handleWsMessage on 'request-offer' or 'peer-joined(tech)' correctly branches: streamRef -> buildAndOffer, CI_NATIVE -> startShare, else setWakePrompt(true).

CryptoInvestViewer.jsx: togglePrivacy sends {type:'privacy',on:!privacyOn}; connect() sends {type:'request-offer'} on WS onopen and again on peer-joined(client). Debounce 1200ms in client via lastOfferRef avoids duplicate offers.

invoicePdf.js: ISSUER.email correctly set to 'victor.silva@wexfordadvisory-ltd.com'; header text 'Documento Original' at line 50; the old string 'Original · Documento não certificado' is no longer present.

Minor: In the viewer, if the client is not sharing and privacy is toggled while wake-prompt is visible, the privacy overlay covers the wake modal (z-70 vs z-60). This is intentional — technician can force a black screen even before share starts.
Nit: 5+ stale sessions accumulate in the panel because /conectar registers on every mount and there's no server-side dedup by device_id for anonymous devices. Consider upserting on device_id.

seed_data_creation: Created one live support session via natural /conectar registration (device_id auto-generated, code=fc766a7e in this run). No cleanup performed; admin can delete stale devices from the panel.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To acquire the client's session code deterministically, attach page.on('response') BEFORE the initial POST /api/public/support/connect fires (e.g., call page.reload() after attaching the handler). Then match the code to the ci-open-{code} button in the panel. To simulate screen share in Chromium without real display picker, override navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia to return a canvas.captureStream(fps). Panel polls /support/sessions every 5s.
